The optimal strategy in a second-price auction is to bid my true value, as this maximizes my expected utility. Bidding below my value risks losing out on profitable opportunities, while bidding above my value risks winning at a price higher than my value (though this specific auction rule makes it safe to bid above value, it doesn't improve expected profit over bidding true value).
